title: Supreme Court says New Hampshire student IDs can’t be used to vote in November - NBC News
description: In a win for Republicans, the court said a federal judge should not have changed the rules so close to the Nov. 3 midterm elections.

title: Judge restricts DHS investigations into noncitizen voting, citing flawed data - The Washington Post
description: The judge put her order on hold until 5 p.m. Friday, giving the Trump administration time to appeal.

title: NYC passes bill to ban horse-drawn carriages, Central Park’s drivers fear for their future - NBC News
description: The horse-drawn carriages that have cruised through Central Park for more than 150 years will soon be banished from New York City, ending an iconic tradition beloved by tourists but long opposed by animal welfare activists.

title: You Only Audition Twice: Watch Henry Cavill, James Brolin, Sam Neill and Others Screen-Test for James Bond - The Hollywood Reporter
description: As a new generation of would-be 007s reportedly lines up at Pinewood, take a look at the famous faces who tested for the tux — but didn't get to keep it.
